breast_cancer.name: Breast Cancer Check
breast_cancer.tagline: Checks cell shape and margin data from lab biopsy tests to detect early signs of abnormal cell growth.
breast_cancer.desc: FNA biopsy nuclear margin and cellular morphometry parameters.
breast_cancer.why_it_matters: Early cellular detection allows minimally invasive interventions before micro-calcifications progress.
warning_signs: Painless, firm solitary breast lump with irregular borders
Skin tethering, dimpling, or orange peel texture
Recent nipple inversion, retraction, or spontaneous discharge
Persistent axillary lymphadenopathy or unilateral swelling
checklist: Gather recent FNA biopsy or ultrasound records
Review cellular radius and perimeter measurements
Verify absence of acute localized infections
Ensure patient demographic profiles are up to date

heart_disease.name: Heart Health Check
heart_disease.tagline: Analyzes blood pressure, cholesterol, resting ECG, and exercise tolerance to detect cardiovascular risks.
heart_disease.survival_rate: 48% Reduction in Major Adverse Cardiac Events
heart_disease.desc: Cardiovascular biomarkers, blood pressure, ST depression, and ECG metrics.
heart_disease.why_it_matters: Identifying sub-clinical arterial plaque buildup years in advance prevents irreversible myocardial infarction.
warning_signs: Retrosternal chest pressure radiating to left arm or jaw
Unexplained shortness of breath on mild exertion
Palpitations, irregular pulse, or sudden dizziness
Persistent bilateral ankle edema or fatigue
checklist: Record resting blood pressure after 5 minutes sitting
Have recent lipid profile results (Total Chol, HDL, LDL) ready
Include resting ECG telemetry strip if available
Note exercise tolerance and past family cardiac history

diabetes.name: Diabetes & Blood Sugar Check
diabetes.tagline: Evaluates plasma glucose, fasting insulin, BMI, and metabolic markers to catch insulin resistance early.
diabetes.desc: Glycemic metabolic panel, glucose tolerance, insulin, and BMI metrics.
diabetes.why_it_matters: Beta-cell dysfunction can be reversed during pre-diabetes before permanent microvascular complications occur.
warning_signs: Increased thirst and frequent nocturnal urination
Unexplained weight loss despite increased appetite
Chronic lethargy and postprandial fatigue
Slow healing cuts, peripheral tingling, or blurred vision
checklist: Record 8-hour fasting plasma glucose in mg/dL
Measure current body mass index (BMI)
Check fasting serum insulin levels if tested
Note family history of Type 2 diabetes

pneumonia.name: Pneumonia & Lungs
pneumonia.tagline: Checks chest radiographs for pulmonary infiltrates, fluid buildup, and early bacterial or viral infections.
pneumonia.survival_rate: 94% Avoidance of ICU and Ventilator Admissions
pneumonia.desc: Radiographic inspection for pulmonary consolidation and parenchymal opacity.
pneumonia.why_it_matters: Distinguishing bacterial vs. viral pneumonia within 48 hours directs life-saving targeted therapy.
warning_signs: Productive cough with purulent or rust-colored sputum
High fever accompanied by shaking chills and diaphoresis
Pleuritic chest pain worsening on deep inspiration
SpO2 dropping below 94% on room air with tachypnea
checklist: Ensure posterior-anterior (PA) chest X-ray is clearly illuminated
Verify DICOM metadata or PNG/JPEG image resolution
Check patient SpO2 level and respiratory rate
Note onset time of fever and productive cough

skin_cancer.name: Skin Cancer & Moles
skin_cancer.tagline: Analyzes dermoscopy lesion photos for border irregularities, color variegation, and early melanoma signs.
skin_cancer.desc: Pigmented dermatoscopic lesion triage and melanoma classification.
skin_cancer.why_it_matters: In-situ melanoma excision carries near 100% cure rate compared to vertical invasive melanoma.
warning_signs: Asymmetrical border or irregular notched edges
Multiple colors (black, brown, red, white, or blue) within one lesion
Diameter greater than 6 mm (pencil eraser size)
Evolving size, shape, surface elevation, or bleeding
checklist: Capture well-lit, in-focus close-up photograph of skin lesion
Ensure no hair or glare obscures lesion borders
Document lesion anatomical location
Note if the mole has grown or bled in the past 6 months

parkinsons.name: Parkinson's Voice Check
parkinsons.tagline: Measures micro-tremors, frequency jitter, and vocal amplitude variations from sustained phonation audio.
parkinsons.survival_rate: 76% Delay in progression of motor disability
parkinsons.desc: Biomedical voice acoustics, vocal jitter, shimmer, and pitch entropy.
parkinsons.why_it_matters: Vocal fold phonatory instability appears up to 3 years prior to cardinal resting tremors.
warning_signs: Micrographia (progressively smaller, cramped handwriting)
Resting hand or finger tremor (pill-rolling tremor)
Hypophonia (quiet, monotone, or breathy voice)
Rigidity and reduced arm swing while walking
checklist: Record sustained vowel /a/ sound in quiet environment
Ensure microphone is 10 cm from mouth at 45 degree angle
Maintain vocal phonation for at least 3 seconds
Review baseline acoustic jitter and shimmer metrics
